name: browser_exec
description: Run a bounded browser script using the original Chrome GUI provider.

code.description: Bounded browser script using the documented helpers. Use print(...) to return data.

session.description: Named browser session within the calling task. Reuse its name for related calls; omission selects that task's default session.

timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a script (default 300, maximum 1800).
